allow_large: One performance change across the board's data path: the same JSON, about three times faster

amendments.because: GitHub search latency sets a floor of about 20 seconds on a cold cache; the pane's wait and error line move to the pane part
amendments.done_when: forge board --json and forge next --json each finish within 10 seconds on a repo the size of Forge's own, and the pane shows the board on its first refresh

done_when: forge board --json and forge next --json make a bounded number of git and GitHub calls, so on Forge's own repo they run about three times faster (board about 11 seconds and next about 8 seconds with a warm GitHub cache) with the same JSON
why: The Forge pane stays on Loading in Forge's own repo, because forge board --json and forge next --json each take about 40 seconds and the pane gives up after 20
